Gigabyte GeForce RTX 5060 Eagle OC ICE 8GB GDDR6 Graphics Card

Elevate your desktop setup aesthetics and rendering speed with the stunning next-generation Gigabyte GeForce RTX 5060 Eagle OC ICE 8GB GDDR6 graphics card, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Beautifully finished in a full-white ICE edition shroud and matching protection backplate, this elite GPU features 8GB of high-speed dedicated memory layout to maximize frame rates effortlessly at mainstream gaming resolutions. Driven by Gigabyte's signature Windforce cooling thermal system, it utilizes three unique blade fans spinning in alternate directions combined with composite copper heat pipes to deliver extreme, whisper-quiet thermal dissipation. With factory overclocking fine-tuned for stable performance upgrades right out of the box, this highly capable white graphics setup is officially backed by a 3-year official agent warranty.
